replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Generally Senior staff are the only ones that can respond to appeals, but I did share my opinion in another forum post, so I'll share it here as well.

I didn't witness the situation ingame, but your forum behaviour is not the best at the moment. If your ingame behaviour is similar to your forum behaviour, this is honestly a valid ban. We will not ban you due to your lag, since it does not say anywhere in our Rules that having 'bad ping' is punishable. If people are disrespectful towards you in any way, /report those players. We do not tolerate disrespectful behaviour from any player, and they'll be deal with if the harassment/disrespect is severe enough.

I'm not going to say "yes stay banned and get permanently banned tomorrow because you're bad", because that is 100% false. If you break our rules (having bad connection is not one of those rules, but what you were banned for is), then you will, of course, be punished again. If you don't break our rules, we won't punish you, since we wouldn't have any valid reason to.

I understand that there's been some issues going on, but there are solutions. /report the disrespectful players, and just try to enjoy your time on the servers as best as you can. If you enjoy playing on the servers, then those bad players should not get in the way of that.

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: Look, we're sorry that you have to go through so much lag whilst playing on the server, but your behaviour towards the situation on the forums, like TheTNTPotato mentioned, is rather rude and sketchy. You appear to be throwing the blame on us for what other players say/your connection, but these two things are situations we can't really control. Sure, we could punish a player if they spam the word 'lagger' in chat or whatnot, but it's unnecessary to act this way towards us over an issue that  many other players go through as well.
